name: Fresca Deli .
notes: 4 photos: 1-2 are a laminated tri-fold menu (mostly smoothies/juices/aguas, plus an unpriced 'Our Specialties' food list); 3-4 are the same yellow priced food board shot close and from afar. Merged food items across boards; skipped pure drink sections (smoothies, juices, frappes, clamatos). Several prices on the yellow board carry correction stickers/redactions (Fruit Salad large size, Nachos/Drinks/Clamato line) so those were taken as printed where legible or omitted.
